title: deordinal configuration
description: Configuration for deordinal.json and deordinal.jsonc. Paths are relative to the configuration file's directory.

$schema.description: URI or path to this JSON Schema for editor validation.

useGitIgnoreFile.description: Respect Git ignore files and .ignore during directory traversal. Explicitly named files are not affected by ignore files.

includes.description: Ordered globs for files to check, relative to this configuration file. A matching pattern sets inclusion to true; a pattern prefixed with ! sets it to false. Later matches override earlier ones. A directory match also applies to its descendants. When omitted, all supported files are included; an empty list includes none. If provided, patterns must positively include a file before exclusions have any effect. Unlike ignore files, this filter also applies to explicitly named files.

items.description: A glob using * for one path segment, ** for recursive segments, or a leading ! for exclusion. Paths are relative and cannot escape the configuration directory.
